items.title: How to play Final Fantasy 14 for free on Switch 2: Over 200 hours of content without paying
items.summary: Final Fantasy 14 is coming to Nintendo Switch 2, and this version lets you play a massive amount of content for free.
items.content:
One of the best MMOs of all time is now available on a handheld console.

Final Fantasy 14 is one of the best MMOs available today. In fact, many consider it the best installment in the series over the past 10 years, both in terms of content and execution. On August 4, it debuts on Nintendo Switch 2 , a moment that will allow players to join the world from anywhere thanks to the console’s design ( and get ready for the 2027 expansion ). Square Enix offers a very generous free-to-play edition, which we’ll detail below.

The “free trial,” as Square Enix calls it, lets all new players enjoy the full Final Fantasy XIV experience with very few limitations. It gives you access to A Realm Reborn, the game’s base campaign, and its three subsequent expansions: Heavensward, Stormblood, and Shadowbringers. With just these, you’ll have at least 200 hours of content to enjoy without paying a subscription fee.

🔵⚫️ Nintendo Switch 2 版 #FF14 ⚫️🔴 🎮 8月4日（火）19:00頃 サービス開始！🎮 いよいよ明日19:00頃より、Nintendo Switch™ 2 で #FF14 をプレイできます✨ 新たなプラットフォームでの冒険をお楽しみください🐤🏃‍♂️ ⬇️ 予約に関する詳細はこちら🔍 🌐 https://t.co/67mUJkWBT7 pic.twitter.com/KFVPYWn5EQ

There are very few limitations to the free trial. Here they are:

As you can see, the restrictions are minimal if you consider yourself a solo player . Throughout all the content you have access to, you practically don’t need any of that. Perhaps the biggest issue is the amount of gil, but it’s not something you have to manage in great detail as you progress through the main quests.

All new players (i.e., those creating a new account on MogStation) who download the free trial and access the game for the first time through it will be able to enjoy this version. If you use an account that purchased the game, this option will no longer be available, and you’ll have to start paying for the subscription.

It’s important to keep in mind that if you want to play for free, you shouldn’t purchase any of the editions available on the Nintendo eShop. When the game launches on August 4, the free trial option will become available—that’s why it isn’t visible in advance . Make sure you have enough storage space: the game requires 117 GB of available space.

On the other hand, if you want to buy it, you’ll get one month of free play without a subscription starting on launch day . With this measure, the developers are preventing people from paying for a new version that may have stability issues with its online infrastructure during its first few days.

items.title: Final Fantasy 14 could finally introduce a controversial feature to welcome new players
items.summary: Square Enix is finally considering making the hundreds of hours of story easier for new players
items.content:
Listen Thread 6 Add Us Add on Google Preferred Source Google News Link copied to clipboard By Willa Rowe Published Jul 29, 2026, 2:49 PM EDT News Producer Naoki Yoshida says the team is considering ways to make the lengthy story easier

FFXIV Evercold will finally modernize some of the MMO's most outdated features Final Fantasy 7 Revelation's director can't promise a physical release, but he wants it Despite Magic's unprecedented success, Wizards' president is already stepping down Final Fantasy 14 could finally introduce a controversial feature to welcome new players Photo: Square Enix Final Fantasy 14 Sign in to your Polygon.com account It is becoming increasingly difficult to recommend Final Fantasy 14 to new players as the years go on. Now in its 13th year of service with a sixth expansion due in January, the MMORPG requires hundreds of hours to complete — and that's if we are just talking about the main story. Despite this Herculean effort, Square Enix has been adamant that players must go through the entire game's story to access the latest content. That could finally be changing.

During a media Q&A at Final Fantasy Fan Fest in Berlin (as reported by PC Gamer ), Final Fantasy 14 producer Naoki Yoshida revealed the development team is working on potential solutions to make the game more accessible to beginners. "I had previously said that I want players to enjoy the story, so I would like them to have a fresh experience right from A Realm Reborn ," Yoshida admitted "But now we are at this point, we've begun thinking about accommodating these kinds of requests."

Yoshida shared that Square Enix is considering two ways to address the issue, though he remained fairly cryptic on both. He said that the first one will be implemented before or at Evercold 's release. He teased that the second solution involves a system whose feasibility the development team is in the process of reviewing. "There's a non-zero possibility of us being able to implement it for [patch] 8.0. So there is a possibility that we could make it," Yoshida said.

While the topic of a streamlined path or skip through Final Fantasy 14 's story remains controversial among the fanbase, it makes sense for Square Enix to consider it at this point in the MMO's life. Evercold , the game's next expansion, marks the start of the Godless Realms Saga. This is something of a new beginning, with the MMO's initial story wrapping up in 2021's Endwalker . It has the potential to be the perfect onboarding point for beginners who have, until now, been intimidated by the game's mountain of quests.

Square Enix has already trimmed the lengthy list of main scenario quests over the years in an attempt to make catching up with Final Fantasy 14 easier, but even this has failed to keep pace with the volume of new story content each expansion adds. There are paid story skips available to players for each expansion, but Square Enix seems ready to consider a free implementation of something similar going forward.

One of the biggest concerns with offering players the ability to jump right in to the latest expansion is how it will affect the rest of the player-base. While the story is important, the hours of playtime it takes to get through it also help players learn just how Final Fantasy 14 's mechanics work. As content still revolves around teaming up with other players, 'the community worries that an influx of players without proper tutorials could harm everyone's experience. Yoshida hinted that more details on potential solutions could come during Tokyo Fan Fest in October.

items.title: Fans Want FF7 Remake Director To Lead Final Fantasy 17
items.summary: Naoki Hamaguchi made a surprise ppearance onstage at the latest FF14 Fan Fest
items.content:
Final Fantasy Final Fantasy VII Revelation Final Fantasy XIV Final Fantasy XVII RPG Square Enix

Who’s going to be put in charge of making Final Fantasy XVII ? It’s a question on fans’ minds, and one that even came up onstage during Final Fantasy XIV ‘s Berlin Fan Fest over the weekend.

Naoki Hamaguchi, who is currently directing Revelation , the third and final game in the Final Fantasy VII Remake trilogy, made a surprise appearance at the event to promote an upcoming Final Fantasy VII crossover with the MMORPG for its Evercold expansion raid. While the Square Enix star was on stage, Final Fantasy XIV director Naoki Yoshida sung his praises.

Yoshida complimented his colleague for how grand and sprawling the remake trilogy is and for the team’s ability to turn around new games fairly quickly. He also pointed to the types of online comments Hamaguchi gets from fans. “There were comments along the lines of, ‘I want this guy to make Final Fantasy XVII ,” Yoshida said via his translator. “So, I think that’s probably the highest praise you can get.”

Did…Yoshi-P just hint that Hamaguchi is maybe working on FF17?? LOL

Yoshi-P: I think it's one of the biggest compliments people were saying in the comments they wish Hamaguchi is making FF17. But you don't have to answer…!

Yoshi-P: No, no, don't! pic.twitter.com/7KaNpK67nM

— ☆オードリーAudrey☆ (@aitaikimochi) July 26, 2026

The Final Fantasy XIV director then quickly butted in to save Hamaguchi from saying something that might fuel even more fan speculation. “You don’t have to answer,” he interjected while laughing.

After two decades of ups and downs from Final Fantasy XIII , to Final Fantasy XV , to Final Fantasy XVI , some fans have been hoping for something more consistent from the franchise. And with the remake trilogy in particular, it feels like Hamaguchi and his team have nailed a decent hybrid of turn-based and real-time action combat, and found a good compromise between open-world exploration and the traditional linear RPG adventure.

Hamaguchi previously said he didn’t know what he’d work on next, but given Revelation won’t ship until early 2027, any new numbered Final Fantasy led by him would probably be quite a ways out. It’s been taking Square Enix roughly seven years to get new entries in the series out. At that rate, we shouldn’t be expecting Final Fantasy XVII , regardless of who directs it, until 2030.

Yoshida also pushed back on some fan requests for applying the Final Fantasy VII Remake formula to other beloved games in the franchise . “So, of course, now because you are working on the Final Fantasy VII series, I do get that people would be asking for remakes of other titles,” he said . “But if we did remake those other titles, we’d probably end up having to release them in four or maybe even five installments.”

items.title: Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold expansion extended teaser trailer and latest details, Switch 2 version launches August 4
items.summary: Square Enix released a five-minute extended teaser trailer and new details for Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold, the patch 8.0 expansion for Final Fantasy XIV due out in January 2027, as well as announc…
items.content:
Sal Romano Jul 25 2026 / 6:00 AM EDT 0 Square Enix released a five-minute extended teaser trailer and new details for Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold , the patch 8.0 expansion for Final Fantasy XIV due out in January 2027, as well as announced that the Switch 2 version of Final Fantasy XIV will launch on August 4.

Pre-orders for the Switch 2 version are available now. As previously announced, the Switch 2 version will require a separate monthly subscription from the other versions, but will not require a Nintendo Switch Online subscription. Users already subscribed on other platforms can receive a 50 percent discount on the Switch 2 version’s subscription fee..

Square Enix also released a new teaser trailer for the Evangelion crossover raid series, “Ghosts of Desire,” and announced a Final Fantasy VII Remake project crossover event, “Beyond the Lifestream.”

Square Enix today revealed brand-new information about Evercold , the sixth expansion for its critically acclaimed MMORPG Final Fantasy XIV Online , set to launch in January 2027 alongside new playable content, a Final Fantasy VII Remake trilogy crossover raid series, the Nintendo Switch 2 version release date, and more.

An extended teaser trailer for Evercold was also revealed, providing a glimpse into the world of the Fourth and the adventures that await the Warrior of Light in the start of the Goddless Realms Saga story arc.

During the Fan Festival 2026 in Berlin keynote address, Producer and Director Naoki Yoshida revealed the first new job coming to Evercold : Bastion—a main tank that wields a pair of greatshields known as skyltborg—and unveiled a trailer showcasing the new job in action.

Details were also shared on several new features coming to Evercold , including changes to the narrative structure that will be implemented for the main scenario, field, and game system, allowing players more freedom to choose what area they complete first between various paths in the main scenario. Through Auto Content Balancing, difficulty scaling and enemy levels will adjust to the appropriate player level as they play through dungeons in their chosen order. Additionally, a first look was provided for Character Action Skins, a feature that lets players assign alternate animations to personalize existing General actions, such as Teleport and Warp, with support for additional skins such as job actions arriving in future updates. Character customization will also be expanded so players have more ways to make their character stand out, including a greater range of color options with the new color picker, the ability to fine-tune features such as eyes and lips, new elements such as eye shadow, and more.

Following the reveal of the Evangelion “Ghosts of Desire” alliance raid series in April, Yoshida unveiled a new teaser trailer and announced that acclaimed director and animator Mahiro Maeda will join the project as a special guest artist and designer. Throughout his career, Maeda has contributed to numerous acclaimed projects, including Mad Max: Fury Road (2015) as a concept artist and designer, and Evangelion:3.0 +1.0 Thrice Upon a Time (2021), where he served as director, concept art director, storyboard artist, art setting designer and key animator.

❮ ❯ Joined on stage by Final Fantasy VII Remake series Director Naoki Hamaguchi, Yoshida also revealed “Beyond the Lifestream,” a new Final Fantasy VII -themed eight-player raid series that players will challenge in Evercold . Both development teams are working closely together to create an exciting new raid experience for players.

Further, Final Fantasy XIV will launch on Nintendo Switch 2 on Tuesday, August 4, 2026, with pre-orders starting today on Nintendo eShop. To ensure server stability, there will be an approximately one-month free subscription period on Nintendo Switch 2. Whether beginning with the Free Trial, starting their adventure with the Starter Edition, or diving into the full story and experience with the Complete Edition, more players than ever before will soon be able to join together in the vast world of Final Fantasy XIV .

An outline of the content reveals from the keynote address can be found below:

Finally, Yoshida revealed the Evercold Collector’s Bundle, which includes a collection of physical items: the Evercold Special Art Box, Expertly Crafted Reaper Figure, Ethos Metal Keychain, Köttr Mini Plush, and Tapestry of the Fourth. Also included is the digital Collector’s Edition, featuring three in-game items: the Crystal Skyltborg bastion weapon, Vallhallar Odin mount, and Entreat Crystal emote. More information regarding availability and pre-orders will be announced in the future.

Final Fantasy XIV is available now for PlayStation 5 , PlayStation 4 , Xbox Series , and PC via Steam . Square Enix said that the new expansion will continue to support PlayStation 4, but that it will soon near its capacity to physically contain Final Fantasy XIV on PlayStation 4, estimating that PlayStation 4 support will end after Patch 8.3—which should arrive in about two years.

Watch a new set of trailers below. View a new set of screenshots at the gallery .

items.content:
The Make It Rain Campaign returns once more to the Gold Saucer! With a 50% MGP bonus and an assortment of adorable otter-themed goods on offer, you won't want to miss out! Furthermore, campaign attendants will be offering a range of items at discounted prices, including some exclusive limited-time deals, so be sure to join the festivities and rake in the rewards while you can!

Event Duration

From Friday, May 29, 2026 at 1:00 a.m. (PDT) / 8:00 (GMT) / 9:00 (BST) / 18:00 (AEST) to Wednesday, June 24, 2026 at 7:59 a.m. (PDT) / 14:59 (GMT) / 15:59 (BST) / Thursday, 25 June at 0:59 (AEST)

How to Participate

Begin the quest "You Otter Be There" by speaking to Ollier in Ul’dah - Steps of Nald (X:9.4 Y:9.1). * Players must be level 15 and above to start the quest. * Players must first complete the quest "It Could Happen to You."

Rewards

* MGP rewards from the Gold Saucer have been increased by 50% for the duration of this event. * Certain items available during previous iterations of the event can be obtained via the campaign attendant. * The Crystal Tower striker, Monster Toss machine, Cuff-a-Cur machine, and a number of other prizes may be purchased at a reduced MGP cost from the campaign attendant. Visit the special site for more details.
